name: zclass_camera_set_view_distance
description: zClass_Camera::SetViewDistance sets the camera auto-clip enable flag and stores either the reciprocal view distance or the default threshold.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zClass camera source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x449ba0 validates a leaf fastcall body with enableAutoClip in ECX and distance on the stack, storing g_zClass_CameraAutoClipDistanceAdjustEnabled and updating g_zClass_CameraAutoClipDistanceThreshold.
Binary Ninja assembly validates storing 0.04f when distance equals 0.0f and storing 1.0f / distance otherwise.
The registered native camera global-setter smoke verifies the enable flag and threshold for 20.0f and zero-distance inputs.
